model_or_product: YF-1; YF-2 Fuzz Box; DA-1 Fuzz Box
evidence_summary: Multiple surviving and documented Yack fuzz products identify Yack as a short-lived Japanese musical-instrument/effects brand with several distinct models. YF-2 is documented as a 1967-1969 Japanese fuzz in collector records, while the DA-1 is independently documented as another late-1960s Yack fuzz. The surviving record is strong enough to preserve Yack as a historical builder/brand lineage, but the underlying corporate legal entity or factory has not been identified and should remain unresolved.
